players.product: Silicon carbide (SiC) substrates: conductive, semi-insulating and P-type (6/8-inch volume, 12-inch launched); also optical-grade SiC for micro-nano optics

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 913,646,546.53, up 15.10% from RMB 793,805,202.95; gross margin 22.86%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB -58,616,647.35 versus RMB 10,880,178.50 a year earlier; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -87,338,412.89. Q2 2026 revenue was RMB 5.48 hundred million, a record quarter, up 42.06% YoY and 49.97% QoQ, with a 25.36% quarterly gross margin and net profit attributable of RMB 189.30 ten-thousand. The company attributed revenue growth to higher output and sales, a larger share of large-diameter products and gradually stabilising prices; the H1 loss reflected foreign-exchange losses (RMB 11,838.05 ten-thousand) and asset and credit impairment provisions, and it says losses are narrowing.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 913,646,546.53 (+15.10%); Q2 revenue RMB 5.48 hundred million (+42.06% YoY, +49.97% QoQ), Q2 gross margin 25.36%

quarterly_data.signal: Operations (half-year report): the company said it ran at full production in H1 2026, downstream orders strengthened markedly and customer demand rose clearly versus earlier periods, as demand expansion and the clearing of supply tightened the industry supply-demand balance; product prices gradually stabilised, and 8-inch products exceeded 50% of main-business revenue. The Shanghai and Jinan plants are advancing second-phase capacity plans and an overseas plant is gradually entering the planned-construction stage. Prepayments rose 55.62% to RMB 188,671,128.78 to secure raw-material supply.
quarterly_data.figure: full production in H1 2026; 8-inch over 50% of main-business revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (half-year report, company statement): the company expects the capacity and market share of its large-diameter SiC products to rise further, will keep cutting costs and push into overseas markets and emerging applications, and expects profitability to improve gradually as scale effects come through; it cautions that margins could still fluctuate or recover more slowly than expected if price competition intensifies again, the large-diameter ramp slows or cost cuts fall short.

R&D and technology (half-year report): H1 2026 R&D expense RMB 74,574,434.24 (-1.68%), 8.16% of revenue, directed at 12-inch substrates, 8-inch yield and cost, P-type substrates and optical / advanced-packaging applications; a new project on low-defect, high-flatness SiC materials (new 8-inch growth furnaces and thermal fields, non-destructive inspection, laser lift-off; budget RMB 200,090,000.00) is in the research stage. The company says 8-inch volume yield keeps improving and unit cost falling, full-size substrate TTV has been brought below 1 μm with double-sided CMP developed for optical-waveguide use, and it says it was first to lay out 12-inch optical-grade SiC substrate processing technology with precise TTV control.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 74,574,434.24 (-1.68%), 8.16% of revenue; substrate TTV below 1 μm

quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress (half-year report): RMB 226,182,785.53 at June 30, 2026 (+75.60%), mainly from SiC substrate capacity-expansion projects; the Shanghai SiC substrate materials project phase II (budget RMB 134,000,000.00) was 59.99% complete, Shanghai equipment awaiting installation RMB 140,727,957.60, and the Malaysia project RMB 4,367,202.17.
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 226,182,785.53 (+75.60%); Shanghai phase II 59.99% complete

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Foxconn (half-year report): SICC says its SiC cooperation with Foxconn Group deepened, citing Foxconn's Sustainable Excellence Supply Chain Award (materials category, gold) received in April 2026; in H1 2026 it was also named a Bosch Group Preferred Supplier, a title the company says goes only to the top 20% of Bosch suppliers.
